references.text: Jesus feeds 4,000 men, in addition to women and children, with seven loaves of bread and a few small fish, and there are seven baskets left over with fragments.
Jesus feeds 5,000 men, in addition to women and children, with five loaves of bread and two fish, and there are twelve baskets left over with fragments.
